title: From NP-Hardness to Exact Tractability Through Sample Abundance
abstract: arXiv:2611.34734v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Additional observations can make exact optimization tractable without changing the objective or feasible set. We establish this phenomenon for noisy parity fitting, a worst-case NP-hard problem, with uniformly sampled rank-one sign tensor entries, independent fair factor signs and independent errors. For fixed interaction order $k\ge3$, $n$ signs per block, logarithmic mean degree and known channel biases, $O(n/(\log n)^{1/(k-2)})$ further readings of the same source suffice with high probability for exact optimization in $O(n\log^2 n)$ worst-case work. The leading coefficient is sharp for weak recovery by depth-$O(\log\log n)$ local estimators with independent reading marks. A common signed-field law determines the gain over the generating source, the number of tied optima and the dimension needed for later reweightings. The geometry of the remaining coordinates determines the sharp radius of local verification for high-scoring assignme

translated_title: 从NP难到精确可解：样本丰裕性带来的转变
translated_abstract: 额外的观测可以在不改变目标函数或可行集的情况下，使精确优化变得可解。我们在带噪声的奇偶校验拟合问题上建立了这一现象——这是一个最坏情况下NP难的问题——其设定包括均匀采样的秩一符号张量元素、独立的公平因子符号以及独立的误差。对于固定的交互阶数 $k\ge3$、每块 $n$ 个符号、对数平均度以及已知的信道偏置，来自同一来源的 $O(n/(\log n)^{1/(k-2)})$ 次额外读取，足以以高概率在 $O(n\log^2 n)$ 的最坏情况工作量内实现精确优化。其主导系数对于采用独立读取标记、深度为 $O(\log\log n)$ 的局部估计器的弱恢复而言是紧致的。一个共同的符号场定律决定了相对于生成源的增益、并列最优解的数量以及后续重加权所需的维度。剩余坐标的几何结构决定了高分赋值的局部验证的锐利半径。
tldr: 该论文证明了对于最坏情况下NP难的带噪声奇偶校验拟合问题，只需 $O(n/(\log n)^{1/(k-2)})$ 次来自同一来源的额外采样，就能以高概率在 $O(n\log^2 n)$ 的工作量内实现精确优化，表明样本的丰富性可以在不改变问题本身的情况下将NP难问题变为精确可解。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that a worst-case NP-hard noisy parity fitting problem becomes exactly tractable with high probability—solvable in $O(n\log^2 n)$ work—given only $O(n/(\log n)^{1/(k-2)})$ additional samples from the same source, showing that sample abundance can convert NP-hardness into exact tractability without altering the objective or feasible set.
